name: esquerda-vs-direita
description: Esquerda vs Direita — jogo de luta 2D (sátira fictícia) empacotado com Capacitor para iOS e Android

scripts.setup:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios --packagemanager SPM && npm run assets && node scripts/configure-native.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.setup:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run assets && node scripts/configure-native.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.serve: npm run build && npx --yes http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
